newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican Energy to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican Energy to buy back shares.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Holdings Co said Thursday its board of directors the repurchase of up to $200 million of its common stock.
The company said it plans to buy the shares from time to time, and plans to complete the program by December 31, 1998.
Dillon, Read & Co Inc has been retained as agent for the repurchase program.

The company said the $200 million authorization will allow it to repurchase more than 10 percent of its shares outstanding at current market prices. Due to higher earnings per share resulting from the repurchase, the company will have a lower dividend payout ratio going forward, Philip Lindner, chief financial officer, said in a statement.

"We had previously announced that cash proceeds from the sale of MidAmerican Energy Holdings' oil and gas properties, completed in January 1997, would be used for a combination of activities that include repurchasing shares of our common stock, reducing company debt and pursuing appropriate investment opportunities," Stanley Bright, president, said in a statement. "We believe MidAmerican common stock represents the best value for our funds today."
MidAmerican Energy Holdings has 101 million common shares outstanding.
Shares were up 5/8 at 17-1/8, after closing Wednesday at 16-1/2.
